#0. Load essential libraries
```{r}
#load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(Seurat)
library(openxlsx)
library(DOtools)

outputFolder <- "/mnt/mariano/Sequencing_Storage/20250128_MRJ001_snRNASEQ_24096_miR143_145-flox_Cdh5_CreERT2_(Cre+_vs_Cre-)_Julian /24096/"
sink(file = paste0(outputFolder,"/analysis/20250128_MRJ001_Julian_24096_snRNA_miR143_145_Script.log"), append = TRUE, split = TRUE)
```

#1. Preprocessing data
##1.1 Prepare Paths for import count matrixes from cellbender outputs
```{r}
Sample_Paths <- c(paste0(outputFolder,"raw-data/cellbender/19_S1"),
                  paste0(outputFolder,"raw-data/cellbender/20_S2"),
                  paste0(outputFolder,"raw-data/cellbender/42_S3"),
                  paste0(outputFolder,"raw-data/cellbender/23_S4"))

Sample_Names <- c("19_S1_ctrl","20_S2_miRNAko","42_S3_miRNAko","23_S4_ctrl")
```

##1.2 Run Importer function on ctrl + miRNA KO mice
```{r}
#import data, create SeuratObjects
resultList<-list()
SeuratObjectList <- list()
for (i in 1:length(Sample_Paths)) {
  resultList<-Importer(pathway = Sample_Paths[i],
                       id = Sample_Names[i],
                       CellBender = TRUE,
                       FilterCells = TRUE,
                       FilterByAbsoluteValues = TRUE,
                       performScaling = TRUE,
                       minFeatures=300,
                       maxFeatures=6000,
                       minCounts=500,
                       maxCounts=15000,
                       maxMito=0.05) 
  
  print(resultList[[2]])
  SeuratObjectList[[i]]<-resultList[[1]]
}

```

##1.3 Add disease information to the objects before integrating 
```{r}
SeuratObjectList[[1]]$condition <- "ctrl"
SeuratObjectList[[2]]$condition <- "miRNAko"
SeuratObjectList[[3]]$condition <- "miRNAko"
SeuratObjectList[[4]]$condition <- "ctrl"

```

##1.4 Integration with CCA method
```{r}
merged_obj <- Reduce(function(x, y) merge(x, y), SeuratObjectList) 

merged_obj <- NormalizeData(merged_obj)
merged_obj <- FindVariableFeatures(merged_obj)
merged_obj <- ScaleData(merged_obj)
merged_obj <- RunPCA(merged_obj)
merged_obj <- JoinLayers(merged_obj)

library(scDblFinder) # Doublet removal
SCE_merged_obj <- as.SingleCellExperiment(merged_obj)
SCE_merged_obj <- scDblFinder(SCE_merged_obj, samples = "orig.ident")
merged_obj$scDblFinder_score <- SCE_merged_obj$scDblFinder.score
merged_obj$scDblFinder_class <- SCE_merged_obj$scDblFinder.class #singlet 60801  doublet  7029
merged_obj <- subset(merged_obj, scDblFinder_class == "singlet") 

merged_obj[["RNA"]] <- split(merged_obj[["RNA"]], f = merged_obj$orig.ident)
Seu_miRNA <- IntegrateLayers(object = merged_obj, method = CCAIntegration, orig.reduction = "pca", new.reduction = "integrated.cca", verbose = T)

#re-join layers after integration
Seu_miRNA <- JoinLayers(Seu_miRNA) # the individual scale layers remain after joining layers, remove them they are just unnecessary memory waste 
layers_to_remove <- grep("^scale\\.data\\.", Layers(Seu_miRNA), value = TRUE)
Seu_miRNA@assays$RNA@layers[layers_to_remove] <- NULL

saveRDS(Seu_miRNA, file = "/mnt/mariano/Sequencing_Storage/20250128_MRJ001_Julian_24096_snRNA_miR143_145-flox_Cdh5_CreERT2 (Cre+ vs Cre-) /24096/analysis/objects/Seu_miRNA_preDoubletfinder.rds")
```


#2. Calculate neighbors, clusters and umap representation
```{r}
Seu_miRNA <- FindNeighbors(object = Seu_miRNA, reduction = "integrated.cca", dims = 1:10)
Seu_miRNA <- FindClusters(Seu_miRNA, resolution = 0.6, algorithm=4, random.seed = 1234)
Seu_miRNA <- RunUMAP(object = Seu_miRNA,
                     reduction = "integrated.cca",
                     dims = 1:10,
                     spread = 1,
                     min.dist = 0.3)



p <- DimPlot(Seu_miRNA, group.by = "seurat_clusters", label = F, cols = umap_colors, raster = F) +
    labs(x="UMAP1",y = "UMAP2")+
    theme(plot.title = element_blank(),
          # text = element_text(face = "bold",size = 20),
          axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, family="Helvetica"),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, family="Helvetica"),
          axis.text.x = element_blank(),
          axis.text.y = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "none",
          legend.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
p <-LabelClusters(p, id  = "seurat_clusters", fontface="bold", box = F)

ggsave(paste0(outputFolder, "analysis/plots/UMAPs/UMAP_seurat_cluster.pdf"), width = 8,height = 8, plot = p)

Seu_miRNA <- DO.CellTypist(Seu_miRNA, runCelltypistUpdate=F)
Seu_miRNA$annotation <- Seu_miRNA$predicted_labels_celltypist

p <- DimPlot(Seu_miRNA, group.by = "predicted_labels_celltypist", label = F, cols = umap_colors, raster = F) +
    labs(x="UMAP1",y = "UMAP2")+

          axis.text.y = element_blank(),

          legend.position = "none",

p <-LabelClusters(p, id  = "predicted_labels_celltypist", fontface="bold", box = F)
```

#3. Define Markers for each cluster

```{r}
#Calculate Top expressed Markers for annotation
annotation_Markers<- FindAllMarkers(object = Seu_miRNA,
                                    assay = "RNA",
                                    group.by = "annotation_refined",
                                    min.pct = 0.25,
                                    logfc.threshold = 0.25)

top_markers <- annotation_Markers %>%
  dplyr::group_by(cluster) %>%
  top_n(n = 5, wt = avg_log2FC)

#kick MT-genes
MT.genes <- top_markers[grep(pattern = "MT-", top_markers$gene),]
top_markers <- top_markers[!(top_markers$gene %in% MT.genes$gene),]

DO.Dotplot(sce_object = Seu_miRNA,
           Feature = top_markers,
           group.by.x = "annotation_refined",
           plot.margin = c(1,1,1,1),
           annotation_x = T, # only useable if Feature is a dataframe with cluster information, e.g. FindAllMakers output (you need a column with cluster)
           point_stroke=0.1,
           annotation_x_rev = T,
           textSize = 14,
           hjust = 0.5,
           vjust = 0,
           textRot = 0,
           segWidth = 0.3,
           lwd = 3
        )

ggsave(paste0(outputFolder,"analysis/plots/dotplots/TopExpressed_genes_per_celltype.pdf"), width = 19, height = 10)

```

#4. DEG analysis per cell type wilcoxon

```{r}
DEG_stats_collector <- list()
for (dis.ident in c("miRNAko")) {
  print(dis.ident)
 for (celltype in unique(Seu_miRNA$annotation_refined)) {
   print(celltype)
   Seu_miRNA_celltype <- subset(Seu_miRNA, subset = annotation_refined == celltype) # for DEG analysis the normal subset function should still work
  
  DEG_stats <- FindMarkers(object = Seu_miRNA_celltype,
                           ident.1 = dis.ident,
                           ident.2 = "ctrl",
                           min.pct = 0,
                           logfc.threshold = 0,
                           assay = "RNA",
                           only.pos = F,
                           test.use = "wilcox",
                           group.by = "condition")
  DEG_stats <- rownames_to_column(DEG_stats)
  DEG_stats[["condition"]] <- dis.ident
  DEG_stats[["celltype"]] <- celltype
  
  DEG_stats_collector <- rbind(DEG_stats_collector, DEG_stats)    
  
 }
}

write.xlsx(DEG_stats_collector, file = paste0(outputFolder, "/analysis/excels/DEG_analysis_nothresh_miRNAko_ctrl.xlsx"))

```

#5. Senescence Score

```{r}
#load senescence marker genes
#Aging Atlas, CellAge, SenMayo, CellularSenescence,Fridman & Tainsky
ff <- list.files(path = "/mnt/mariano/scStorage/DavidR/BioData/SenescenceScore/", pattern = "AgingAtlas*", full.names = TRUE, recursive = F)
counts.files <- lapply(ff, read_csv)
counts <- do.call(rbind, counts.files)
AA_DF <- data.frame(Symbol=unique(counts$Symbol),
                    dataset="AgingAtlas")

CellAge <- read_tsv("/mnt/mariano/scStorage/DavidR/BioData/SenescenceScore/CellAge3.tsv")
CellAge <- CellAge[CellAge$`Senescence Effect` == "Induces",]
CA_DF <- data.frame(Symbol=unique(firstup(tolower(CellAge$`Gene symbol`))),
                    dataset="CellAge")

SenMayo <- read.xlsx("/mnt/mariano/scStorage/DavidR/BioData/SenescenceScore/SenMayo_Genes.xlsx", sheet = "mouse")
SM_DF <- data.frame(Symbol=unique(SenMayo$`Gene(murine)`),
                    dataset="SenMayo")

FridTain <- read_csv("/mnt/mariano/scStorage/DavidR/BioData/SenescenceScore/Fridman&Tainsky.csv")
FT_DF <- data.frame(Symbol=unique(firstup(tolower(FridTain$SYMBOL))),
                    dataset="FridmanTainsky")

library(GO.db)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
go_terms <- as.data.frame(GOTERM)
Sen_GO <- go_terms[go_terms$Term %in% "cellular senescence",]$go_id
gene_id <- unlist(mget(Sen_GO, org.Mm.egGO2ALLEGS, ifnotfound = NA))
gene_symbols <- mapIds(org.Mm.eg.db, keys = gene_id, keytype = "ENTREZID", column = "SYMBOL")
CS_DF <- data.frame(Symbol=unique(gene_symbols),
                    dataset="GO:0090398")

Sen_DF <- rbind(AA_DF,CA_DF,SM_DF,FT_DF,CS_DF)
# write.xlsx(Sen_DF, file = paste0(outputFolder,"analysis/excels/Senescence_markers_DF.xlsx"))


#use combined genes to define senescetic cells
Sen_DF_present <- Sen_DF$Symbol[Sen_DF$Symbol %in% rownames(Seu_miRNA)]
```

#7. Receptor Ligand analysis using CellChat

##7.1 Create CellChat object for miRNAko
```{r}
library(CellChat)
library(patchwork)

miRNA_obj_ko <- DO.Subset(miRNA_obj,
                          ident = "condition",
                          ident_name = "miRNAko")

#CellChat assumes a column called samples with orig.ident information
miRNA_obj_ko$samples <- miRNA_obj_ko$orig.ident
miRNA_obj_ko$samples <- factor(miRNA_obj_ko$samples)

CC_miRNAko <- createCellChat(miRNA_obj_ko,
                           group.by = "annotation_refined",
                           assay = "RNA")

#Initialize CellchatDB
CellChatDB <- CellChatDB.mouse
CC_miRNAko@DB <- CellChatDB

CC_miRNAko <- subsetData(CC_miRNAko)
CC_miRNAko <- identifyOverExpressedGenes(CC_miRNAko)
CC_miRNAko <- identifyOverExpressedInteractions(CC_miRNAko)

#Try their projection approach to reduce dropout effects
CC_miRNAko <- CellChat::smoothData(CC_miRNAko, adj = PPI.mouse)

#Communication propability
CC_miRNAko <- computeCommunProb(CC_miRNAko, population.size = T) 
CC_miRNAko <- computeCommunProbPathway(CC_miRNAko)

#Aggregated cell-cell communication
CC_miRNAko <- aggregateNet(CC_miRNAko)
CC_miRNAko <- netAnalysis_computeCentrality(CC_miRNAko)

```

##7.2 Create CellChat object for ctrl
```{r}
miRNA_obj_CTRL <- DO.Subset(miRNA_obj,
                          ident = "condition",
                          ident_name = "ctrl")

#CellChat assumes a column called samples with orig.ident information
miRNA_obj_CTRL$samples <- miRNA_obj_CTRL$orig.ident
miRNA_obj_CTRL$samples <- factor(miRNA_obj_CTRL$samples)

CC_CTRL <- createCellChat(miRNA_obj_CTRL,
                           group.by = "annotation_refined",
                           assay = "RNA")

#Initialize CellchatDB
CellChatDB <- CellChatDB.mouse
CC_CTRL@DB <- CellChatDB

CC_CTRL <- subsetData(CC_CTRL)
CC_CTRL <- identifyOverExpressedGenes(CC_CTRL)
CC_CTRL <- identifyOverExpressedInteractions(CC_CTRL)

#Try their projection approach to reduce dropout effects
CC_CTRL <- CellChat::smoothData(CC_CTRL, adj = PPI.mouse)

#Communication propability
CC_CTRL <- computeCommunProb(CC_CTRL, population.size = T) 
CC_CTRL <- computeCommunProbPathway(CC_CTRL)

#Aggregated cell-cell communication
CC_CTRL <- aggregateNet(CC_CTRL)
CC_CTRL <- netAnalysis_computeCentrality(CC_CTRL)
```

```{r}
                 sources.use = which(levels(CC_merge@idents$joint) != target_names),
                 targets.use = 7,
                 comparison = c(1,2),
                 angle.x = 45,
                 color.text = DOtools:::umap_colors)

build_p <- ggplot_build(p)
plot_names <- build_p$layout$panel_params[[1]]$y$get_labels()
plot_names <- plot_names[!grepl("Ptprm  - Ptprm",plot_names)]

pairLR_all <- CellChatDB.mouse$interaction
pairLR_use <- pairLR_all[pairLR_all$interaction_name_2 %in% plot_names,]$pathway_name

netVisual_bubble(CC_merge,
                 sources.use = which(levels(CC_merge@idents$joint) != target_names),
                 targets.use = 7,
                 comparison = c(1,2),
                 angle.x = 45,
                 color.text = DOtools:::umap_colors,
                 signaling = pairLR_use)

ggsave(paste0(outputFolder, "analysis/plots/cellchat/LigandReceptor_analysis_others_to_",target_names,".pdf"), width = 8, height = 13) 


#create incoming-outgoing scatter plot for ECs between conditions
gg1 <- netAnalysis_signalingChanges_scatter(CC_merge,
                                          idents.use = "EC",
                                          color.use = DOtools:::umap_colors,
                                          top.label = 1,
                                          # signaling.exclude = c("PTPRM","PECAM1"),
                                          comparison = c(1,2))
gg1 <- gg1+
DOtools:::theme_box()+
labs(title = paste0("Signaling changes upon miRNAko in ", "EC"))+
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black",angle = 0,hjust = 1, size = 14),
        axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 14),
        axis.title.x = element_text(color = "black", size = 14),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
        axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
        strip.text.x = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
        legend.position = "right",
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10, color = "black", family = "Helvetica"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 10, color = "black", family = "Helvetica", hjust =0))+
guides(color = ggplot2::guide_legend(title = "Specifity", order = 1),
       shape = ggplot2::guide_legend(title = "Direction", order = 2))
gg1
ggsave(paste0(outputFolder, "analysis/plots/CellCHat/Signaling_changes_in_EC_upon_miRNAko.pdf"), width = 8, height = 7)
```

#8. Load HCA data
```{r}
Human_HCA <- readRDS("/mnt/mariano/Temporary_Restore/Mariano/Human_Mice_Comparison/Seurat_and_R_objects/260402_Human_HF_complete.rds")
Human_HCA <- DO.Subset(Human_HCA, ident = "disease", ident_name = c("CTRL.SP", "CTRL.LV"))
Human_HCA$annotation <- plyr::revalue(Human_HCA$annotation, c("Ven_EC" = "EC",
                                                              "Lym_EC" = "EC",
                                                              "Cap_EC" = "EC",
                                                              "Art_EC" = "EC"))
DO.UMAP(Human_HCA, group.by = "annotation")

#assign young old cutoff 55 years
table(Human_HCA$AGE)
Human_HCA$broad_AGE <- ifelse(Human_HCA$AGE %in% c("40-45", "45-50", "50-55"), "young", "old")
table(Human_HCA$broad_AGE)
```

#9. Dotplot expression Collagene genes
```{r}

collagenegenes <- c("Col3a1", "Col5a2", "Col15a1", "Col8a1", "Col4a1")

#check if genes are in rownames
lamagenes %in% rownames(miRNA_obj)
collagenegenes %in% rownames(miRNA_obj)

df_dotplot <- data.frame(
    gene = c(collagenegenes),
    cluster = c(rep("Collagen",5))
)



#as Violin plot
for (gene in c(lamagenes, collagenegenes)) {
    DO.VlnPlot(
        tmp_EC,
        Feature = gene,
        group.by = "condition",
        ctrl.condition = "ctrl",
        group.by.2 = "all",
        test_use = "wilcox",
        vector_colors = c("lightgrey", "firebrick4")
    )
    
    ggsave(paste0(outputFolder, "analysis/plots/Vlnplot_", gene, "_ECs_without_EndEC_wilcoxon_ctrl_miRNAko.pdf"), width = 4, height = 5)
    
}


#statistics in Mean SEM plots

stat_df <- data.frame()
for (gene in c(lamagenes, collagenegenes)) {
    
    bar_df <- DO.Barplot(
        tmp_EC,
        Feature = gene,
        group.by = "condition",
        ctrl.condition = "ctrl",
        test_use = "wilcox",
        bar_colours = c("lightgrey", "firebrick4"),
        returnValues = TRUE
    )
    
    br_df <- bar_df$df.melt.sum
    br_df$p_adj <- bar_df$stat.test$p.adj
    
    stat_df <- rbind(stat_df, br_df)
    
}

write.xlsx(stat_df, file = paste0(outputFolder, "analysis/excels/Mean_SEM_Bar_stats_EC_without_EndEC_laminin_collagen.xlsx"))
```
